title: AI Chips And Big Bank Earnings Preview: TSM, ASML, JPMorgan, BofA And More
source_used: Investor's Business Daily video page (only a short episode description; no article body)
key_facts: The IBD episode is a preview of upcoming earnings from Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM), ASML and JPMorgan Chase (JPM).
It highlights what investors need to watch about AI growth, capital expenditure plans and financial sector sentiment.
It says big tech and major financials are about to kick off earnings season.
quote_evidence: Big tech and major financials are about to kick off earnings season!

On this episode, we preview key upcoming reports from Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM), ASML (ASML) and JPMorgan Chase (JPM), highlighting what investors need to watch regarding AI growth, capital expenditure plans and financial sector sentiment.
why_it_matters_hint: Chip and bank results next week will test how strong AI demand and spending really are.
notes: Video page with a short description only; no article text. Yahoo Finance's explainer gives ASML reporting on 14 Oct 2026 and TSMC on 15 Oct 2026, but that is not used in the entry.
